name: Kawakol–Danwar District road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR 87, Kawakol–Danwar District road, crosses the border between Bihar and Jharkhand. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — Bihar RCD and Jharkhand RCD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
